answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond native tokens to participate in consensus. This economic gravity creates a ripple effect where malicious identity proliferation incurs prohibitive capital costs, effectively thinning the agent nebula. By staking assets, participants anchor their influence to a verifiable financial grove, ensuring that an attacker must acquire significant supply to disrupt the network, thereby aligning their incentives with system integrity.
